prompt: I have a new Python project at /tmp/test-project with some markdown docs in a docs/ folder. Initialize a documentation wiki for it with domain 'backend-services', ingest docs/architecture.md (about JWT auth and session management), and then query 'how does authentication work?'.

assertions.text: Runs init_wiki.py (or init_wiki.ts) script to create directory scaffold
Directory scaffold includes wiki/, raw/, graph/, audit/, log/, outputs/
Source file is copied to raw/ directory
A wiki page is created with proper frontmatter (title, type, tags, sources, created, updated, summary)
summaries.md is updated with the new page's summary
Query answer includes inline citations to wiki pages
events.jsonl records init, ingest, and query operations
